title: Holiday places-Greece
titleCn: 希腊家庭度假预订咨询

paragraphs.text: First, you have some time to look at questions one to six on page two.
Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Hello, Holiday Places. Can I help you?
Hi. I'm thinking of booking a holiday in Greece and wondered if you could help me.
When were you thinking of traveling?

We were going to go at the beginning of August, but I've got to change the dates now. So I'm looking at a week's holiday sometime in September. The kids go back to school the week of the 25th, so I'd suggest the 15th. We can't leave it as late as October.
Okay. How many people is it for?

Well, originally, my parents and brother were going to come, but for one reason or another, they can't make it, so it'll be just the four of us. Anyway, I don't think seven people staying all together would have been very comfortable.
Right. Before we go any further, I just need to take a few more details. What name is it?
It's Harcourt. That's H-A-R-C-O-U-R-T.
Great. I'll need your passport numbers and address later on, but for now, can I just take your contact telephone number?
Yes, of course. It's 0125334470.
Thank you. Now, what kind of accommodation were you thinking of? We can cater for everyone, so I'm sure we'll be able to find something suitable for you and your family.
Well, I'd have preferred a nice little hotel myself, but my husband thinks it would be better to book an apartment, just a small one. Then we can look after ourselves. I suppose he's right, really.
Okay, what kind of facilities are you looking for?

There definitely needs to be a pool because the kids love splashing about. My husband and I both play tennis, so it would be nice to have a court for that. My husband plays golf too, but he's not so worried about doing that on holiday.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
Let me see. I've got some accommodation here that sounds good. It's in a little town on the coast.
Oh, fantastic. What is there to do there?
There's a lovely park, and the sea is quite shallow, so it's good for children. Last year, they had a club for them too, run on the beach. I'll check if that's still running this year. Shall I?
Yes, please. That sounds great. What about day trips?
There's a castle and some islands you can visit. Actually, you can book some trips before you go. Is there anything in particular you might like to do?
I've always wanted to go out on a boat with one of those glass bottoms, you know, so you can look at the fish underwater.
I know just the thing. There's a trip from the harbor that leaves three times a day. Shall I put you down for one of those?
Yes, why not? Book that for the second day. I think we'll need a rest on the first day after all that traveling, and that'll be something to look forward to.
Now, about your flight to the resort. Do you or your family have any special dietary requirements for food on the plane?

Well, my husband doesn't eat meat. He's vegetarian, and my seven-year-old son doesn't eat cheese. My daughter's five and loves her food. She'll eat fish, rice. There's nothing she won't try. What about when we arrive at the airport? Will there be someone to collect us?

Yes, one of our representatives. Then the coach trip takes around two hours. It has to drop people off at different resorts. Or you can get a taxi. They're expensive, but it means you'll get to your accommodation much quicker.
Yeah, that would probably be better.
Great. So if I can just get a few more details, uh...
That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
